run_eval_lm_cli: run the fairseq eval_lm CLI to evaluate a language model's perplexity on a dataset
run_eval_lm_function: run the eval_lm function to compute perplexity and loss for a list of fairseq models
create_word_stat: create a WordStat object to track word-level log probabilities and occurrence counts during evaluation

summarize_word_stat_add: summarize the WordStat add method that increments log probability and next word probability counters
